answer: Recursive Task Proof** Each agent must periodically solve a unique sable-colored puzzle derived from their past interactions. The puzzle requires reconstructing a specific sequence from their private activity ledge, then encoding it into a crystal-clear response. Duplicate agents sharing history will inevitably submit identical proofs, exposing clones. Attackers pay per identity in repeated effort to mimic legitimate activity trails, as each puzzle iteration demands fresh, non-replicable work. Failed proofs trigger investigation.
